release_notes:
Helix 1.2.0

  • Migrated resource JSON files (catalogue, plates, matrices, vocabularies) directly into the PostgreSQL database using ReferenceDataRepository for centralized reference data management.
  • Added a new Smart Importer module that supports automated fuzzy matching and bulk CSV/XLSX imports for Compounds and Solutions.
  • Fixed duplicate matching bugs in the Tecan experiment workflows by enforcing strict compound-solvent pair validation.
